{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "MASTER PROMPT — Create a playful but trustworthy static editorial news website in Vue for a mental-health magazine called “MindSprout Daily”. It should feel like a premium news/editorial platform inspired by Amazon’s clarity, card layout, recommendation rows, mega navigation, trust badges, and easy browsing UX, BUT it is not an ecommerce site. Use only static/mock/sample content, no backend, no login, no account, no database, no live APIs, no real-time news feed. Everything should render as a static Vue front-end.

Overall concept: MindSprout Daily is a friendly mental-health news hub for young adults, families, students, and professionals. Tone should be optimistic, playful, warm, and science-aware. The site should look like a real modern editorial publication with many sections, article cards, category pages preview, featured story blocks, “recommended reads”, and newsletter-style CTA, but all content can be hardcoded.

Tech requirements:
- Build with Vue, preferably Vue 3 + Vite.
- Static front-end only.
- Use reusable components: Header, MegaMenu, HeroEditorial, ArticleCard, CategoryRail, TrendingTicker, ParallaxSection, ExpertQuoteCard, MoodFilter, Footer, etc.
- No external API calls.
- No authentication.
- No backend or database.
- Mock article data in a local JS/JSON file is perfect.
- Fully responsive desktop/tablet/mobile.
- Smooth parallax interactions while scrolling, using CSS and lightweight Vue scroll effects only. No WebGL, no Three.js, no 3D engine.

Visual direction:
- Playful editorial news style, not clinical and not boring.
- Reference Amazon layout ideas: strong top header, search-like visual bar, horizontal category strips, “Because you read…” recommendation rows, deal-style badges transformed into “Quick Read”, “Editor’s Pick”, “5 min calm”, etc.
- Color palette: warm cream background #FFF7EA, mint green #74D3AE, soft lavender #BFA7FF, sunny yellow #FFD166, coral #FF7A6B, deep navy text #1D2A3A.
- Use rounded cards, soft shadows, sticker-like labels, subtle grain texture, playful illustrations/shapes, floating blobs.
- Typography: large friendly serif or rounded display for headlines, clean sans-serif for body.
- Layout should be complex and content-rich like a real editorial homepage.

Header / Navigation:
- Top tiny trust bar: “Independent wellness journalism • Reviewed by mental-health professionals • New guides every week”
- Main nav inspired by Amazon: logo left “MindSprout Daily”, large fake search bar in center with placeholder “Search stress, sleep, therapy, burnout…” but it does not need functional search beyond visual/static or simple local filtering if easy.
- Right side: “Today’s Mood”, “Saved Reads” visual only, “Subscribe” button.
- Second nav strip with categories:
  Latest News, Anxiety, Sleep, Therapy, Workplace, Relationships, Student Life, Mindful Tech, Opinion, Guides.
- Mega menu dropdown visual on hover/click for categories with static links and colorful mini cards.

Homepage sections:
1. HERO EDITORIAL NEWS SECTION
- Big headline: “Mental health news that feels lighter to read.”
- Subheading: “Friendly reporting, practical guides, and expert-reviewed explainers for the noisy modern mind.”
- Left: lead story card with large image/illustration placeholder and category badge “Featured Report”.
- Lead story title: “Why micro-breaks are becoming the new workplace wellness headline”
- Summary and author/date.
- Right: stacked “Top Stories Today” cards.
- Add playful parallax floating elements: paper notes, smiley badge, small cloud, little sprout icon moving slowly on scroll.
- CTA buttons: “Read Today’s Brief” and “Explore Calm Guides”.

2. BREAKING BUT GENTLE TICKER
- A horizontal ticker styled like a news update bar but calm: “Gentle Updates: New sleep guide • Therapist Q&A • Burnout checklist • Digital boundaries report”. Static loop animation ok.

3. AMAZON-STYLE CATEGORY RAILS / RECOMMENDED ROWS
- Multiple horizontal article rows like a shopping site recommendation carousel but for articles:
  “Recommended for a calmer week”
  “Most read in anxiety”
  “New in sleep science”
  “Editor’s playful picks”
- Each card has badge, title, short summary, reading time, author, mood icon.
- Cards should be colorful and varied.
- Horizontal scroll on mobile.

4. MOOD-BASED NEWS BROWSER
- A section titled “Browse by how your brain feels today”.
- Mood pills: Overwhelmed, Curious, Tired, Hopeful, Stressed, Socially Drained.
- When selecting a pill, visually filter or highlight static article cards; simple Vue state is fine, no backend.
- Add microcopy: “Not medical advice — just a friendly starting point.”

5. FEATURED PARALLAX STORY
- Large immersive parallax editorial block with layered background shapes.
- Story: “The quiet rise of mental-health days in schools”
- As user scrolls, background blobs and illustration layers move at different speeds.
- Include statistics-style cards with mock numbers: “68% of students say rest helps focus”, “4 min average read”, “12 expert tips”. Make clear this is sample editorial/mock content if needed.

6. DAILY BRIEF GRID
- Complex grid layout similar to a news homepage:
  Big story card, two medium cards, four small cards.
- Categories: workplace burnout, therapy access, social media habits, sleep routines, loneliness, mindfulness apps as an editorial topic only, family conversations.
- No real app integrations.

7. EXPERT REVIEW PANEL
- Section with cards for fictional experts:
  Dr. Lena Park, Clinical Psychologist
  Marcus Hill, Workplace Wellness Researcher
  Amira Santos, Family Therapist
- Each has a quote and “Reviewed for clarity” badge.
- Use playful profile circles/illustration placeholders, not real photos required.

8. GUIDES LIBRARY
- Amazon-like browsing shelves for guides:
  “Start Here Guides”, “Deep Dives”, “Quick Calm Tools”, “For Managers”, “For Students”.
- Static guide cards with cover-like visuals.
- Include a sidebar called “Popular topics” with tag chips.

9. COMPARISON / EXPLAINER SECTION
- Title: “Mental-health terms, explained without the jargon”
- Cards explaining stress vs burnout, sadness vs depression, worry vs anxiety, rest vs avoidance.
- Friendly tone, no diagnosis claims.

10. NEWSLETTER CTA
- Big playful signup-style block: “Get the kinder news brief.”
- Include email input visually, but no real submission required. Button can show a small local success message like “Thanks! Static demo only.”
- Mention weekly gentle reads, expert explainers, and practical checklists.

11. FOOTER
- Columns: Sections, Resources, About, Editorial Standards.
- Disclaimer: “MindSprout Daily is a static demo editorial website. Content is sample-only and not a substitute for professional medical advice.”
- Social links as static icons.

Article content requirements:
- Create at least 24 mock article objects locally with title, category, summary, author, date, readTime, moodTag, badge.
- Use realistic but fictional titles.
- Avoid alarming imagery; make it calm, friendly, and hopeful.
- Include sample categories and tags.

Interactions:
- Parallax scroll in hero and featured story.
- Sticky header.
- Hover animations on cards.
- Category rail horizontal scrolling.
- Mood pill filtering/highlighting using local state.
- Mega menu static dropdown.
- Newsletter fake success message using local state.
- Smooth anchor scrolling.

Responsive requirements:
- Desktop: rich multi-column editorial layout.
- Tablet: two-column grids.
- Mobile: stacked sections, horizontal card rails, compact nav menu.
- Make sure text remains readable and accessible.

Accessibility:
- Good color contrast.
- Semantic HTML sections.
- Alt text for decorative/editorial images or aria-hidden decorative shapes.
- Keyboard-friendly buttons and links.

Final deliverable should be a polished static Vue website with playful mental-health news/editorial vibes, complex homepage structure, parallax interaction, Amazon-inspired browsing/recommendation layout, and entirely mock/static content only.",

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
# webdev-structural-gate@1: necessary conditions, not a replacement judge.
_gate_layout = {}
for _line in (shot["output"] or "").splitlines():
    if _line.startswith("LAYOUT:"):
        try:
            _gate_layout = json.loads(_line[len("LAYOUT:"):])
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass
        break
if (not isinstance(_gate_layout, dict) or _gate_layout.get("error")
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("text"), str)
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("scroll_w"), (int, float))
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("client_w"), (int, float))
        or _gate_layout["client_w"] <= 0):
    done(None, "Structural measurements unavailable; not scored.")
_gate_text = " ".join(_gate_layout["text"].split())
_gate_kw = cfg.get("gate_keywords") or []
_gate_fails = []
if not _gate_text:
    _gate_fails.append("blank rendered DOM")
if _gate_kw and not any(_kw.casefold() in _gate_text.casefold() for _kw in _gate_kw):
    _gate_fails.append("no brief-keyword DOM presence")
if _gate_layout["scroll_w"] > _gate_layout["client_w"] + 1:
    _gate_fails.append("horizontal overflow")
_gate_report = {"passed": not _gate_fails, "failed": _gate_fails,
                "dom_chars": len(_gate_text), "keywords": _gate_kw,
                "layout": _gate_layout}
(V / "structural_gates.json").write_text(json.dumps(_gate_report, indent=1))
if _gate_fails:
    done(0.0, "Structural gates failed: " + "; ".join(_gate_fails),
         structural_gates=_gate_fails)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Gate trivial, off-brief and overflowing pages to a scored 0 before the vision call, cutting judge spend and the blank-page lottery. Passing pages reach the judge unchanged.

, large fake search bar in center with placeholder
